div.div: 5 تفجّع He (a man, S, O) expressed, or manifested, pain, affliction, or distress; or uttered lamentation, or complaint; syn. تَوَجَّعَ; (S, O, K, TA;) لَهُ [by reason of it]; (S;) or لِلْمُصِيبَةِ [by reason of the calamity, or misfortune; (O, K, TA;) and writhed, or cried out and writhed; by reason of it. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
